name: smithsonian-mcp-server
description: Search, explore, and retrieve CC0 media from 19.4 million Smithsonian Open Access objects across 20+ museums via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: Search, explore, and retrieve CC0 media from 19.4 million Smithsonian Open Access objects across 20+ museums via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
interface.longDescription: Six tools covering the full Smithsonian Open Access workflow: search 19.4M objects from 20+ museums with rich filters, discover valid filter vocabulary terms, fetch normalized object metadata, retrieve CC0-licensed images at multiple resolutions, browse by category (museum/culture/period/medium), and discover related objects across collections. Requires a free api.data.gov API key.
